cs.REMISE EN CAUSE (8 oct. 2026, Ancestry): ZPOCHYBNĚNO (8. 10. 2026, Ancestry): při sňatku 10. 7. 1855 v Buteni je Vencelovi 33 let (nar. kolem 1822) a pochází z „Blany(?) in Bohemia“ (12. 10. nově čteno „Hanyin“). To neodpovídá Václavovi narozenému 8. 1. 1831 ve Šťáhlavech (v roce 1855 24 let), tím spíše, že jiný Wenzel, syn Václava a Antonie Baudové, žije ve Fichtenbachu 1868–1907. Křest z 1831 tu zůstává do rozhodnutí: Vencel může být bratranec (např. syn Josefa, nar. 1784, hajného v Kamínkách). Přesto stojí za zmínku: někdo si v roce 1925 vyžádal výpis křtu z 1831.

ZPOCHYBNĚNO (8. 10. 2026, Ancestry): při sňatku 10. července 1855 v Buteni bylo Vencelovi 33 let (nar. asi 1822) a pocházel z „Blany(?) in Bohemia“. To nesedí s Václavem narozeným 8. ledna 1831 ve Šťáhlavech (v roce 1855 by mu bylo 24), tím spíš, že jiný Wenzel, syn Václava a Antonie Baudové, žil v letech 1868–1907 ve Fuchsově Huti. Křest z roku 1831 zde zůstává, dokud se to nerozhodne: Vencel může být bratranec (například syn Josefa, nar. 1784, revírníka v Kamínkách). Pozor však: v roce 1925 si někdo vyžádal výpis křtu z roku 1831.
cs.Raison du départ vers Doksy (recoupement: Důvod odchodu do Doks (porovnání pramenů, 7. 10. 2026): hrabě Kristián Valdštejn-Vartenberk, pán na Šťáhlavech od roku 1816, zdědil 13. srpna 1832 po smrti svého otce Arnošta severočeská panství, mezi nimi Doksy (Hirschberg) (Sommer, Bunzlauer Kreis, 1834, s. 169). Rodina opustila Šťáhlavy po dubnu 1832 a v roce 1834 už byla ve Starých Splavech: Václav velmi pravděpodobně následoval svého pána na jeho nová panství (doklad o přeložení zatím nenalezen). Sommer (s. 172) popisuje „Thamer Revier“ (1 868 jiter, asi 1 075 ha buků, borovic a smrků) a oboru zřízenou v letech 1825–1826, která jej zahrnovala: místo pro zkušeného myslivce. Týž hrabě koupil roku 1847 panství Borossebes v Uhrách, kde byly v letech 1847–1857 v Menyháze usazeny české rodiny: tak se tam zřejmě dostal i Vencel.
cs.Rattachement de ce Vinzenz au fils de Vá: Ztotožnění tohoto Vinzenze se synem Václava narozeným v roce 1832: velmi pravděpodobné (stejné vzácné jméno, stejné povolání, stejný zaměstnavatel), zápisem nedoloženo.
cs.Rattachement à Gustav Macharovský et Mar: Napojení na Gustava Macharovského a Marii Žitkovou je VELMI PRAVDĚPODOBNÉ, ale zatím neprokázané (přečíst křestní záznam: Náchod, únor 1902): Gustav, syn Antonína z Bílé Hlíny, se oženil v Náchodě roku 1900 a Jaroslav vyrůstal u Mnichova Hradiště, odkud rodina pocházela. Psán též Macharowsky.
cs.Rattachement à Josef (né en 1784) : PROB: Spojení s Josefem (nar. 1784): pouze PRAVDĚPODOBNÉ (věk, povolání i zaměstnavatel souhlasí; rodiče v úmrtním zápisu neuvedeni). Otec Marie (nar. asi 1857, zemřela v Mimoni 27. 3. 1894).

cs.Récit consigné par l'IRO : né en 1902 à: Záznam IRO: narozen 1902 v Pule židovským rakousko-uherským rodičům (otec Maďar, matka z terstské rodiny); pokřtěn 1913, protestant; vojenské školy, pak studium chemie na budapešťské univerzitě do roku 1921, kdy doprovodil matku do Milána a zůstal tam kvůli místu chemika. 1939–1944: vrchní recepční v hotelu Diana Majestic v Miláně; v listopadu 1944, hledán SS, utekl do Švýcarska (tábory Bellinzona, Palerna[?], Lugano, Saint-Cergue); 28. dubna 1945 zpět v Miláně, opět v hotelu Diana, pak hotel Eden (říj. 1946 – květ. 1948) a hotel Marino Scala (do dubna 1950). Od dubna 1950: Grand Hotel Villa Balbi v Sestri Levante. Jeho maďarský pas z roku 1938 už neplatí; do Maďarska se vrátit nechce, ale rád by navštívil matku, která žije v Budapešti.
cs.Récit de la grand-mère (oct. 2026) : Gyö: Vyprávění babičky (říj. 2026): György měl sestru, rodiče byli šlechtici. Sestra měla bratrovi platit studia, ale prý zpronevěřila peníze rodičů; otec ji pak už nechtěl vidět. S manželem prý koupila velmi velké železářství, „největší v Budapešti“. Kandidátka: Anna Macharovszky (nar. kolem 1862 v Borosjenő, Arad), manželka Miksy Mayera, v roce 1897 komisionáře. Obchod je třeba dohledat v budapešťských adresářích.
cs.Récit de la grand-mère Jeannine (oct. 20: Vyprávění babičky Jeannine (říj. 2026): když byla s otcem v Paříži, často vídala strýce. Velmi pravděpodobně jde o něj. Chybí ve francouzském rejstříku úmrtí od roku 1970 (matchID): zemřel před rokem 1970, nebo mimo Francii.

Vyprávění babičky Jeannine (říj. 2026): teta v Itálii, která prý žila v Miláně a zemřela v Sestri Levante. Velmi pravděpodobně jde o Margit: sestru Jeannina otce (János), provdanou v roce 1925 za Jenő/Zeno Weichherze, bytem v Miláně (Viale Piave 42). Jediná známá teta spojená s Itálií. Potvrdit úmrtním zápisem (obecní úřad Sestri Levante); v Itálii se mohla jmenovat „Margherita Weichherz“ nebo si ponechat „Macharovszky“.
cs.Réfugié de la révolution hongroise de 19: Uprchlík z maďarské revoluce roku 1956, prošel táborem v Salcburku. Odjezd 14. 12. 1956 transportem „FR/9“ do Francie; uvedený konečný cíl: Austrálie. Pas vydán v Rakousku.

PRAVDĚPODOBNÁ SESTRA VENCELA (neprokázáno). Argumenty: stejné příjmení, stejná generace, rovněž provdaná za lesníka v Banátu nebo v Aradu; rodiny si navzájem chodí za kmotry (Maria Barton kmotrou nejstarší dcery Vencela v roce 1855; Emanuel a Maria Bartonovi kmotry syna Cathariny v roce 1863); ozvěna křestních jmen (Wenceslaus Henricus u Vencela 1861, Henricus Venceslaus u Cathariny 1863, Wenceslaus u Bartonových 1858). cs.Theodor Macharovský, 28 ans, réserviste: Theodor Macharovský, 28 let, rezervista c. k. 36. pěšího pluku a kupec v Bělé č. 93, „syn Václava Macharovského, lesníka v Thammühlu č. 9, okres Doksy, a Anny [= Antonie] rozené Boudové z Mirošova č. 11“, narozen v Thammühlu 9. 11. 1841. Kněz nejprve napsal „Jana“, opraveno na „Václava“. Nevěsta: Anna Bendová, 22 let, narozená v Kluku 3. 10. 1847. Otec není uveden jako zesnulý, ačkoli zápis z roku 1863 (Tuhaň) ho uvádí jako mrtvého: kněz v roce 1870 zřejmě opsal křestní list.
cs.Tradition familiale (non prouvée) : nobl: Rodinná tradice (neprokázaná): polská šlechta, hraběcí titul, dům na Rynku Głównym 20 v Krakově (erby Starykoń a Prus III, bez známé souvislosti). Mosazné pečetidlo nalezené u Sándora: samotná koruna s 11 perlami, bez štítu (tvar hraběcí koruny). Negativní pátrání: maďarské Libri Regii, polská armoriála (Niesiecki, Boniecki, Uruski), polští bojovníci 1848–49. Nalezené zápisy naopak ukazují myslivce z Čech.
cs.Trouvé pendu au bord de la Jizera, sur l: Nalezen oběšený u Jizery v bakovském katastru v září 1899 (kolem 16. hodiny; den není uveden, mezi zápisy z 21. září a 14. října), pohřben v říjnu v 7 hodin ráno hrobníkem, bez kněze. Vdovec z Malé Bělé, 74 let. Úřední ohledání (č. 86).

cs.Uj Lap et A Mai Nap, 16-17 août 1935 : l: Uj Lap a A Mai Nap, 16.–17. srpna 1935: Mezinárodní komise maďarských matek oceňuje 826 matek početných rodin z Budapešti; seznam „özvegy Balogh Sándorné 15, Macharovszky Györgyné 14, Oravecz Mihályné 14…“. Viktória tedy měla 14 dětí (strom jich má 12: některé chybějí, nebo ještě nebyly nalezeny ty, které zemřely mladé).

Zápis přečten 20. 10. 2026 (vodítko: index Ancestry 62342, záznam 5340292): 4. února 1809 před Jeanem Huguesem Delvolvém, zástupcem starosty Moissacu, sňatek „Pierra Chalona, rolníka, narozeného v Castelsarrasinu desátého února sedmnáct set osmdesát sedm“, syna zesnulého Bertranda Chalona, nádeníka, zemřelého v Castelsarrasinu 7. května 1793 (?), a zesnulé Marianne Bedel (? čteno „Bedia“), zemřelé rovněž v Castelsarrasinu 14. března 1793, bydlícího v části Saint-Martin-de-Latour (?) v Moissacu; a „Jeanne Lacassagne, narozené v Moissacu dvanáctého května sedmnáct set devadesát dva, sedmnáctileté“, nezletilé dcery Géranda (?) Lacassagne, rolníka, a Louise (?) Verlié (?), přítomných a souhlasících, bydlící s nimi v téže části. Ohlášky 15. a 22. ledna. Svědci: Antoine Mauret, zemědělec, 41 let; Jean Berbié, zemědělec, strýc nevěsty z matčiny strany (?), z Moissacu; Jean Bedel, rolník, 60 let, strýc ženicha z matčiny strany, a Jean Bedel, rolník, 49 let, z Castelsarrasinu. Podepsal jen Mauret.

Zápis přečten 20. 10. 2026 (vodítko: index Ancestry „Tarn-et-Garonne, narození, sňatky a úmrtí“ 62342, záznam 1064678): „osmnáctého února sedmnáct set čtyřicet čtyři, po vyhlášení ohlášek dvě po sobě jdoucí neděle, Antoine Alary, nádeník, syn Antoina Alaryho a Catherine Leygue, manželů, z farnosti Saint-Paul-d'Elburgues, a Françoise Servat, dcera Jeana a Jeanne Calles (?), z farnosti Saint-Simphorien (?), s dispenzí od třetí ohlášky“, svatební požehnání; přítomni Jean Dubourg, … Bonis, Antoine Pitmegea (?) a Guillaume Belvèze (?), negramotní; podepsán Faidy, kaplan. en.14 oct. 2026 : Vencel de Hongrie n'est p: 14 Oct. 2026: Vencel of Hungary is not his brother (the Václav of 1831 died at Fichtenbach in 1893); he is more probably his first cousin, from the Planin family.
en.14 oct. 2026 : son père probable Wenzel: 14 Oct. 2026: her probable father Wenzel Waniek is “Kreisjäger” then “Revierförster” at Mednay (a village in the parish of Svébořice/Schwabitz, Mimoň estate) from 1822 to 1850 at least (baptism of Liberata, Holičky 1822; marriage of Rosa, 1846). Barbara is not in the birth index of this parish (1792-1830): born around 1819-1821 elsewhere, before the family arrived (lead: parish of her mother Veronika Kunert, Gut Altaicha, or the Svijany estate near Turnov).

en.33 ans à son mariage ; originaire de « S: 33 at her marriage; from “Svavity(?) in Bohemia” (uncertain reading). Surname spelt Vanik, Wanyek, Vanyek, Vanyik, Vaněk or Vangek depending on the record.

Aged 33 at her marriage; from “Svavitz in Bohemia” (re-read 12 Oct 2026: the final z is identical to the one in “Raschowitz” on the same page). Hungarian “Sv” = German “Schw” → Schwabitz, the German name of Svébořice (vanished village in the Ralsko military area, Mimoň estate, 12 km from Doksy); the only place of that name in Czechia. To be confirmed by her baptism (SOA Litoměřice, Svébořice registers, c. 1822). Surname written Vanik, Wanyek, Vanyek, Vanyik, Vaněk, Vangek depending on the record.

en.ANALYSE DE PATERNITÉ (15 oct. 2026) — Mi:
PATERNITY ANALYSIS (15 Oct. 2026) — Is Michel Bally the biological father of Jean?
What the records say: Jean is born on 20 Nov. 1835 at Nouhant, “Jean Duplaid, natural son” of Marie Mazure, day labourer; no father named. Michel Bally is then a widower (his 1st wife Françoise Chatard died around 1827, date to be confirmed): nothing legally prevented him from acknowledging the child as early as 1835. On 8 Jan. 1849, Michel marries Marie Mazure at Nouhant and both declare that Jean was born of them: acknowledgement and legitimation. Michel dies in 1866 at La Chaumette, “husband of Marie Mazure”: the couple remained together for 17 years.
For: voluntary and joint acknowledgement; same commune, related families (Michel and Marie are second cousins, great-grandchildren of Étienne Bally); Jean is thereafter treated as a legitimate son (Bally surname, 1863 marriage with the consent of Michel, “present”).
Against / doubt: 13 years of waiting before the marriage; an acknowledgement “of convenience” was legally possible.
Possible explanations for the delay (hypotheses): social gap (Michel a landowner and municipal councillor; Marie a day labourer); kinship in the 3rd canonical degree requiring a dispensation from the Church.
Not verifiable online: Nouhant censuses of 1836-1846 (only those of 1866 and later are online at the AD23). Remaining leads: marriage dispensation (diocesan archives of Limoges), Michel's estate in 1866 (enregistrement records, Boussac office).
Conclusion: Michel's paternity PROBABLE, not provable.
en.ANALYSE DE PATERNITÉ (15 oct. 2026) — Pa:
PATERNITY ANALYSIS (15 Oct. 2026) — Is Paul Bailly the biological father of Jack?
Chronology checked against the records: marriage of Paul and Juliette Lefèvre dissolved by judgment of 1 Dec. 1920, transcribed on 4 April 1921 → Paul is legally free at the time of Jack's conception (around June 1921). Birth on 14 March 1922 under the name “Jack Dèche”, father not named, declared by a seamstress; mother living at 47 rue Caumartin (Paris 9e). Acknowledged by his mother on 7 April 1922, by Paul Bailly on 24 April 1928, legitimated by the marriage of 7 Nov. 1936 (Maisons-Laffitte), where Paul and Joséphine live together at 18 bis rue de la Muette.
CAUTION: contrary to an initial hypothesis, the ban on acknowledging a child born of adultery did NOT apply (divorce already pronounced): Paul could have acknowledged him as early as 1922 and waited 6 years.
For: voluntary acknowledgement, then marriage and legitimation; lasting relationship until Joséphine's death (1937); a second son, Jean, according to the eolland tree (to be verified).
Against / doubt: 6-year delay (relationship not yet official? temporary separation? Paul is 48 in 1922); an acknowledgement of convenience remains legally possible.
Remaining leads: Maisons-Laffitte censuses of 1926 and 1931 (AD78, arranged by street — 18 bis rue de la Muette in 1936); birth of Jean Bailly, Jack's brother (date, declarant, acknowledgement).
Conclusion: Paul's paternity PROBABLE, not provable; genealogical DNA testing is prohibited in France (art. 16-10 C. civ., 226-28-1 C. pén.).
WHAT THE CENSUSES ADD (read on 15 Oct. 2026, AD78):
- 1921: Paul is not yet at 18 bis rue de la Muette (address occupied by another family).
- 1926 (Jack is 4, not yet acknowledged): Joséphine Élodie Dèche lives in Paul's household as “housekeeper”, Jack is listed as “Dèche”, “son of the preceding”. The relationship is thus concealed behind domestic employment; Paul is already housing the mother and child.
- 1931 (after the 1928 acknowledgement): Jack is listed as “Bailly”, “son” of the head of household; his mother becomes “friend”.
- 1936 (March, before the marriage): same situation, with a second son, Jean Bailly, born in 1932 at Maisons-Laffitte.
Interpretation: the continuous cohabitation of Paul, the mother and the child from 1926 at the latest, the birth of a second son in 1932 and the official shift from “son of the housekeeper” to Paul's “son” after 1928 form a consistent possession of status (possession d'état). The delay in acknowledgement is more plausibly explained by social propriety (a “housekeeper” rather than an official mistress, Paul being a man of standing and a lawyer/business agent) than by any doubt about paternity. This STRENGTHENS the probability that Paul is the biological father, without constituting proof.
en.ARGUMENT FORT : en 1855, la même branche: STRONG ARGUMENT: in 1855, the same branch of the Counts Waldstein (Münchengrätz line) owned Šťáhlavy (birthplace of Václav), Mnichovo Hradiště (Rečkov / Malá Bělá, where his cousin František lived) and, in Hungary, Borossebes and Monyásza (Menyháza, birthplace of György). Between 1847 and 1857, the leaseholder Rosthorn settled 10 to 14 Bohemian families in Jumelt (Menyháza). The Macharowskýs, foresters of the Waldsteins, may have been transferred from one estate to another.
en.ATTENTION (8 oct. 2026) : un Wenzel Mach: WARNING (8 Oct 2026): a Wenzel Macharowsky, son of the late Wenzel (Revierjäger at Šťáhlavy) and Antonia Bauda, lived at Fichtenbach (Fuchsova Huť, near Folmava) from 1868 to at least 1907: assistant forester, then district forester, married to Barbara Anderle, children born 1868-1874. If he is the Václav born in 1831, the identification with Vencel of Menyháza fails. See the entry “Wenzel Macharowský (Fichtenbach)”.
en.ATTENTION : ce jumeau est mort en févrie: CAUTION: this twin died in February 1788 (marginal note on the baptism). The “More Bailly, his son, farmer at Lacaud” who declares the death of Maur senior in 1804, and the “Maur Baly, paternal uncle and guardian” of Michel in 1810, are therefore one or more other people: perhaps a younger son also named Maur (born around 1790-1794, not found) or a relative. To be clarified.

en.Acte lu le 16 oct. 2026 : « Jean Lavilla: Record read on 16 Oct. 2026: “Jean Lavilladieu, of the place of Cavelnaut (?), parish of Saint-Julien de Goudourville, died in the faith of the Church, aged about seventy-four and fortified with the sacraments, on the twenty-third of August one thousand seven hundred and thirty-five, and was buried in the cemetery of the said parish on the following day”. en.Acte lu le 17 oct. 2026 : le 4 septembre: Record read on 17 Oct. 2026: on 4 September 1808, before the mayor of Goudourville, there appear “François Delpech, aged twenty-seven years as is established by the registers of his commune, weaver, living at Labro (?), commune of Clermont-Dessus [Clermont-Dessous ?], canton of Puymirol, department of Lot-et-Garonne, of full age, son of Guillaume Delpech and of Antoinette Besombes (?), who died at Clermont on the thirty-first of December 1783”, and “Jeanne Catusse, aged twenty-seven years, born at Goudourville on the twenty-ninth of the month of March, living at Goudourville, of full age, daughter of Jean Catusse and of Jeanne Dessus-Lamothe”. Banns published at Goudourville and at Clermont-Dessus (place of residence of the groom-to-be) on 31 July and 7 August. Witnesses: Pierre Coucalet (?), 54, day labourer at Espalais (?), friend of the groom-to-be; Barthélemy Couderc, 37, day labourer of Goudourville; François Ragou (?), farmer, 56, friend of the bride-to-be, of Goudourville; Pierre Dessus-Lamothe, 68, uncle of the bride-to-be, of Goudourville. Difficult to read in places.

en.Acte lu le 18 oct. 2026 (n° 1) : Pierre: Record read on 18 Oct. 2026 (no. 1): Pierre Neveux, servant at la Cotte-Brote (?), commune of Ciron, born at Chalais on 12 Ventôse Year VII, of full age, son of Jean Neveux and Marie Proly (?) (note “le quinze vendémiaire l'an onze”: death of the mother?), living at Cochet, commune of Ciron, present and consenting; Marie Tellier, minor, born at Oulches on 25 March 1810, daughter of Michel Tellier, ploughman, and Marie Gachet, living at Oulches. en.Annonce légale obligatoire (« unique pub: Mandatory legal notice ("single publication"): it informs suppliers that the manager is no longer liable for the business's debts; objections to be filed within 20 days with the company, at the office of Rodier, legal adviser, 12 rue de Lancry, Paris 10e. The reason for ending it is not given (end of contract, sale, family decision… unknown). Leads: ask Jeannine (almost 7 in January 1946); look for the notice of the start of the management in the same journal (1943-1945), which would give the start date and length of the contract.
en.Annonce légale parue dans les Archives c: Legal notice published in the Archives commerciales de la France of 22 February 1946, p. 598. The business belonged to the SARL "Restaurant au Cordon Bleu". The reason for ending it is not stated. Jean, a maître d'hôtel, may have worked in this restaurant.

en.Appelée « Jeanne Julia Laffitte » dans l: Called “Jeanne Julia Laffitte” in her daughter's marriage record (1936); living at Nérac in 1936.
en.Appelée « Madeleine » dans l'acte de déc: Called “Madeleine” in her husband's death record (1847), corrected by a judgment of 24 Oct. 1855.
en.Après 1832 la famille quitte Šťáhlavy po: After 1832 the family left Šťáhlavy for the Waldstein estates in northern Bohemia (Doksy / Hirschberg): the father is Revierförster at Thammühl there, the son Anton (c. 1835) Forstadjunkt at Nový Berštejn (1863 record). This strengthens the hypothesis: Vencel would have gone to the Waldstein estate in Hungary (Boros-Sebes / Monyásza).

en.Baptisé le 10 avril 1906 par le chapelai: Baptised on 10 April 1906 by the chaplain Jan Jelínek. Godparents: Ladislav Macharovský (his uncle), train conductor at Smíchov no. 40, and Josef Zeman (his grandfather), railway official at Horažďovice no. 4.
en.Baptisé le 10 janv. 1909. Notes en marge: Baptised on 10 Jan. 1909. Notes in the margin: confirmed in 1921; left the Catholic Church and later returned.
en.Baptisé le 15 nov. 1903. Index : père «: Baptised on 15 Nov. 1903. Index: father “Gustav Macharouský”, mother “Marie Lílková” (= Žitková, mis-indexed).
en.Baptisé le 1er avril 1868 par P. Karl Tr: Baptised on 1 April 1868 by Fr Karl Trnka, curate. Midwife Franziska Bauer of Ober-Vollmau. Godmother: Franziska Bauer, standing in for Josef Anderle, district forester at Nepomuk, and his wife Barbara.
en.Baptisé le 28 novembre 1861 à Menyháza (: Baptised on 28 November 1861 at Menyháza (Ancestry coll. 5412, record 4091382, image 00023).
en.Baptisé le 31 mai 1860 à Buteni (registr: Baptised on 31 May 1860 at Buteni (register 31, p. 40, no. 17). Address Szelezsán no. 99. Godparents: Venceslaus Pohl and Henrica Jahn. This baptism is not indexed on Ancestry (found by browsing the register).
en.Baptisé le 7 nov. 1874 (paroisse de Bode: Baptised on 7 Nov 1874 (Bodenbach parish, Weiher section no. 14). The father is called there “son of Johann [sic] Macharovsky, forester at Thammühl no. 9, and of Antonia née Bauda, of Mirošov”: the grandfather's first name is a mistake, the 1870 marriage record does say Václav.
en.Baptisé le jour même ; prénom non indexé: Baptised the same day; first name not indexed (perhaps an emergency baptism at birth).
en.Baptisé par Joachim Findraff, curé. Sage: Baptised by Joachim Findraff, parish priest. Midwife: Johanna Ullmann, of Horní Rokytá.
en.Baptisé par P. Mathias Kalaš, administra: Baptised by Fr Mathias Kalaš, administrator. Godparents: Michael Schwank, standing in for the godfather, and Leopoldine Seitz, standing in for the godmother Maria Mack(?).
en.Baptisé « Georgius Fridericus » le 27 fé: Baptised “Georgius Fridericus” on 27 February 1863 at Menyháza. Father “Wenceslaus Macharsfky, venator” (huntsman), mother Barbara Vanyek. Address Menyháza no. 36. Godparents: Henrietta Kinsky (already godmother of Wenceslaus Henricus in 1861) and Georgius Landa, estate accountant (“rationista”): György was named after his godfather. Parish administrator: Simon Graff.
en.Baptisée le 18 avril 1860 à Menyháza (An: Baptised on 18 April 1860 at Menyháza (Ancestry coll. 5412, record 4091349, image 00020).
en.Baptisée le 3 juin 1869 par P. Anton Kry: Baptised on 3 June 1869 by Fr Anton Kryčl. Godparents: Josef Anderle, shop clerk, and Karl Anderle, assistant forester.
Baptised by the chaplain Josef Pavec.
en.Baptême (jour mal lu, vers le 15) : mais: Baptism (day hard to read, around the 15th): house no. 12, daughter of Petr Machalowský and Kateřina Waltrová. Baptised by Maximilian Perták, chaplain.

Baptism: house no. 12, daughter of Petr Macharowský, gamekeeper, and Kateřina Waltrová. Probably died young (another Marie was born in 1799).
en.Baptême : maison n° 12, fils de Petr Mac: Baptism: house no. 12, son of Petr Macharowský, gamekeeper (myslivec), and Kateřina Waltrová. Baptised by the chaplain Antonín Perták.
en.Baptême : maison n° 16, fille de Petr Ma: Baptism: house no. 16, daughter of Petr Machalowský, gamekeeper (myslivec), and Kateřina Walterová.
en.Baptême : maison n° 30, fils de Petr Mac: Baptism: house no. 30, son of Petr Machalowský, gamekeeper (myslivec) at Kamínky, and Kateřina née Woltrová; baptised by the curate Josef Pánek. His father died four months later.
en.Baptême : maison n° 31 (?). Père : Josef: Baptism: house no. 31 (?). Father: Josef Macharowský, forest warden (fořt) of Kamínky, subject of the Šťáhlavy estate. Mother: Marie, daughter of Jan Weishäupl, gamekeeper of Kamínky (reading to be confirmed). Died aged 3 months, 8 March 1814.
en.Baptême : maison n° 46, fils de Petr Mac: Baptism: house no. 46, son of Petr Machalowský, gamekeeper, and Kateřina Wolfová, free persons; baptised by the chaplain Maximilian Perták. Index: Chválenice 02, letter M (book IIII, fol. 46).
en.Baptême : maison n° 46, fils de « Petrus: Baptism: house no. 46, son of “Petrus Machalowsky, frei” (free) and “Catharina Walterin”; godparents Johann Přibáň and Marianna Wotawová (?), of Chválenice.
en.Baptême : mère « Pesch Terez », sans pèr: Baptism: mother "Pesch Terez", no father given; register p. 470, line 950.
en.Baptême : « Adalbertus Machalowsky », ma: Baptism: “Adalbertus Machalowsky”, house no. 12, son of Petrus Machalowsky, hunter (Jäger), and “Katharina Walterin, of Šťáhlavy”. Baptised by Mathias Freygang. Probably died young (another Vojtěch was born in 1802).
en.Baptême : « Wácslaw », maison n° 12, fil: Baptism: “Wácslaw”, house no. 12, son of Petr Macharowský (written Machalowský), gamekeeper (myslivec), and Kateřina (written “Waltrowá”). Baptised by Mathias Freygang, parish priest. Godparents: Wácslaw Šimek, subject of Chválenice, and Magdalena …ová, of Borek. Index: Porta fontium, Chválenice 02 (birth index 1732-1804), letter M, images 0380-0390. Consistent with his age of 28 at his 1824 marriage.
en.Baptême de Václav, fils de Václav Machar: Baptism of Václav, son of Václav Macharowský, forest guard at the château (no. 72), and of Antonia Laudy/Bauda (Šťáhlavy 01, image 80; extract issued on 18 April 1925). Linked to Wenzel de Fichtenbach on 14 Oct. 2026: his death record (20 August 1893) gives him 62 years, i.e. a birth in 1830-1831.
en.Baptême de sa fille Maria (Hirschberg, 2: Baptism of his daughter Maria (Hirschberg, 25 Dec 1846): “Johann Macharovsky, manorial forest hunter, son of Josef Macharowsky, district forester at Stiahlau [Šťáhlavy] no. 12, Šťáhlavy estate, and of Maria née Weishäupl, from there, no. 3”. He is therefore a son of Josef (born 1784) and a first cousin of Václav's sons, who also went to the northern Waldstein estates.
en.Baptême de « Jan Macharowský », né le 8: Baptism of "Jan Macharowský", born 8 December 1814 and baptised on the 9th, house no. 31. Father: Josef Macharowský, forest warden (fořt) of Kamínky, subject of Šťáhlavy. Mother: Marie, daughter of Jan Weishäupl, gamekeeper at Kamínky. Identification with Johann of Hirschberg (1846): very likely (same parents, Josef and Marie Weishäupl).
en.Baptême le 10 mars 1786 : maison n° 36,: Baptised 10 March 1786: house no. 36, daughter of “Petrus Machalowsky, venator” (gamekeeper) and “Catharina Wolfin, Stiahlaviensis” (of Šťáhlavy). Index: Chválenice 02, letter M. Probably died young (another Anna was born in 1793).
en.Baptême lu le 16 oct. 2026 (piste : arbr: Baptism read on 16 Oct. 2026 (lead: Geneanet tree chemanla): “Antoine Lavilledieu, natural and legitimate son of Vital, ploughman, and of Élisabeth Celis [Selsis], married, inhabitants of the present parish of Saint-Julien of Goudourville, and born at the place called la Tuque (?), same parish, on the twenty-first of December one thousand seven hundred and sixty-three, and on the following day was baptised in the present church; his godfather was Antoine Chadirac, maternal uncle, inhabitant of Malause, and his godmother Élisabeth Lavilledieu, paternal aunt, inhabitant of Pommevic”; present Pierre Sanson, who signed; signed Vidalot, vicar. (Age given as 42 in year XIII, 40 in 1804.)
en.Baptême lu le 16 oct. 2026 : « Vital Lav: Baptism read on 16 Oct. 2026: “Vital Lavilledieu, son of Pierre and of Jeanne Lamaison, married, was born on the ninth of February and baptised the same day of the year 1722; the godfather was Vital Lavilledieu, the godmother Françoise Lamaison; the witnesses were Jean Molimard and Jean Dios”; signed Molimard, curate. (The Geneanet tree chemanla gives 8 February.)
en.Baptême lu le 16 oct. 2026 : « l'an mil: Baptism read on 16 Oct. 2026: “in the year one thousand seven hundred and fifty-nine and the twenty-seventh of March was baptised in the church of Saint-Paul-d'Elburgues Antoine Balzac [sic], son of Raymond, ploughman, and of Marguerite Bonal, married, our parishioners of the place called la Catoue [Catoune], born the previous day”; godfather Antoine Boyé, godmother Catherine Moursac (?) of the parish of Sainte-Fècle; the father absent; signed Carraton, curate.

Baptism read on 16 Oct. 2026: “in the year one thousand seven hundred and fifty-six and the twenty-eighth of May was born Antoine Malzac, son of Raymond and of Marguerite Bonal, married; he was baptised on the thirtieth of the said month and year; had as godfather Antoine Bonal, as godmother Marguerite Alary, widow of Jean Dubourg; present were Hugues Rispe and Étienne Boyé, who did not sign, not knowing how”; signed Beaussely, curate.

Baptism read on 16 Oct. 2026: “in the year one thousand seven hundred and eighty-one and the first of April was baptised Marianne Beaurredon, daughter of Guilhaume Beaurredon called Vidalou, labourer, and of Isabeau Cassan, born on the thirtieth of the month of March, her father and mother inhabitants of the parish of Saint-Hilaire de Durfort”; godfather Étienne Bodes (?), legal practitioner, of the parish of Saint-Amans-de-Pelagal; godmother noble demoiselle Marianne de Rose (?); the father absent; signed Diderou (?), curate. Her marriage record (1812) says she was born on 1 April (day of the baptism).

Baptism read on 16 Oct. 2026: “in the year one thousand seven hundred and seventy-eight and the twenty-sixth of April was baptised Guillaume Malzac, born the previous day, of the lawful marriage of Antoine Malzac, ploughman, and of Françoise Alary [called] Monplaisir, his wife, inhabitants of the place called Jordy, parish of Saint-Paul-d'Elburgues; had as godfather Guillaume Alary [called] Monplaisir, his maternal uncle, as godmother Marguerite Bonal, his paternal grandmother”, both of the parish, illiterate; signed Dona (?), curate. NB: his marriage record (1812) gives 26 April 1778.
en.Baptême lu le 16 oct. 2026 : « l'an mill: Baptism read on 16 Oct. 2026: “in the year one thousand seven hundred and ninety-two, on the third day of the month of August, was baptised Jean Badourés, born the same day, of the lawful marriage of Jean Badourés, carpenter, and of Guillaumette Itié, inhabitants of the parish of Saint-Jean-de-Perges; his godfather was Jean Badourés, tailor, his paternal uncle, and his godmother Marie Thomas, his paternal grandmother”, illiterate; signed Térondel (?), parish priest. Date confirmed by his marriage record (1822).
en.Baptême lu le 17 oct. 2026 : « Le sesièm: Baptism read on 17 Oct. 2026: “On the sesième (sixth? sixteenth?) of January one thousand seven hundred and eighty was born and baptised Jeanne Catusse, legitimate daughter of Pierre Catusse and Jeanne Dessus-Lamothe, spouses; her godfather was Pierre Dessus-Lamothe and her godmother Jeanne Dessus-Lamothe; the present baptism was performed in the presence of Jean Couderc and Tolé (?), who did not sign”; signed Ponsuc (?). Very probable identification (mother and godfather identical to those at the 1808 marriage), despite the marriage record, which says she was born “on the twenty-ninth of March” and aged 27, and names her father Jean (here Pierre).
en.Baptême trouvé (14 oct. 2026) : Františe: Baptism found (14 Oct. 2026): František, born 18 Nov. 1825 at Planiny no. 12, son of “Pan Josef Macharowsky, myslivec na Planinách” and of Marie, daughter of the late Jan Weishäupl, keeper at Kamínky no. 32; baptised by Thomas Lischka, administrator. The date of 17 Aug. 1825 “at Kamínky” given by his death record (1899) is therefore approximate.
en.Baptême à Buteni, parents Venceslaus Mac: Baptised at Buteni, parents Venceslaus Macharovszky and Barbara (Ancestry). Her 1884 marriage record gives her birthplace as Boros-Sebes (Borossebes); the “Borosjenő” of 1897 is probably a mix-up.
en.Beau-frère : Pierre Marlot, 35 ans en 18: Brother-in-law: Pierre Marlot, 35 in 1884, stonecutter in Saint-Saulge (husband of a sister of Julien, or brother of his wife? “brother-in-law of the groom”).
en.Budapesti Czím- és Lakásjegyzék (annuair: Budapesti Czím- és Lakásjegyzék (address directory) 1901-1902, p. 1274: "Macharovszky György keresk. s., IX Üllői út" — shop assistant. The street number is on the full page.
en.Bulletin officiel des chemins de fer de: Official bulletin of the Austrian State Railways: “Macharovsky Theodor, Conducteur in Bodenbach”, in a list of conductor promotions (probably appointed “Wagenaufseher”, carriage inspector; reading of the list to be checked on the image).
en.Bűnügyi Körözések Lapja (bulletin des av: Bűnügyi Körözések Lapja (wanted-notice bulletin), 10 May 1947: "Macharovszky Gyula … apjának neve Macharovszky György, anyjának leánykori neve Pesch Viktória" (father György Macharovszky, mother née Viktória Pesch). The reason and his date of birth are on the full page (Arcanum subscription, or free at a partner library).
en.Bűnügyi Körözések Lapja, 13 mars 1948, r: Bűnügyi Körözések Lapja, 13 March 1948, section for withdrawn notices (körözésvisszavonások), no. 2110.
en.CONSCRIT DE 1842 : l'Oberamt de Šťáhlavy: CONSCRIPT OF 1842: the Šťáhlavy estate office summons the men born in 1822 who are absent “with or without permission, whereabouts unknown”, and lists “Wenzel Macharowský aus Wesella N. K. 3”. Same year of birth as Vencel (33 in 1855) and already gone: it is almost certainly him. Veselá is the municipality to which the Kamínky forest lodges belong (Petr died there at no. 30 in 1806, Josef at no. 33 in 1840; František, Josef's son, is “of Veselá no. 30” in the 1846 list). House no. 3 is still to be identified (perhaps a misprint for 33 or 30). No baptism of a Wenzel in 1821-1823 at Veselá/Kamínky: he was born elsewhere but belonged to Veselá.
en.CONTEXTE : Nebílovy, Šťáhlavy et Choceni: CONTEXT: Nebílovy, Šťáhlavy and Chocenice belonged to Jan Vojtěch Černín z Chudenic, Supreme Master of the Hunt of the Kingdom of Bohemia (nejvyšší lovčí), builder of Kozel hunting lodge (1784-1789). This explains Petr's move from Netunice to Šťáhlavy (same lord). Source: https://dspace.zcu.cz/items/92cbf6e7-be82-47d2-b6ce-aadefacf8ef8 . Parish of Blovice (Chocenice estate) checked without result: index 1734–1771 (births, marriages, deaths, "Blovice 04" and "05") and marriage and death index 1772–1784 ("Blovice 07").
en.CORRECTION : la table décennale donne «: CORRECTION: the decennial table gives “Mazure (Marguerite), daughter of Nicolas and of Anne Bally, born 4 September 1793” (and not about 1797 as in the jeansebmartin tree).
en.Carte d'arrivée : « MACHAROVSZKY, Vilma: Arrival card: “MACHAROVSZKY, Vilma”, stateless, passport no. 1916, born 7 May 1900 in Budapest. Arrived in New York on 31 October 1962 on Sabena flight 3551, boarded in Brussels. Admitted as a refugee (“Refugee-Escapee Parole”, Act of 14 July 1960). US address: Msgr Cyril J. Potocek, 451 Madison Avenue, New York (seat of the archdiocese; Msgr Potocek looked after Catholic refugees from Central Europe).
en.Charpentier à Saint-Jean-de-Perges (Laba: Carpenter at Saint-Jean-de-Perges (Labarthe) in 1791-1792; weaver at Maillé (?), commune of La Française, in 1822, according to his son's marriage. His brother Jean Badoulès, tailor, was godfather in 1792.
en.Chasseur / garde-chasse (« venator ») su: Huntsman / gamekeeper (“venator”) on the Borossebes estate.
en.Chez ses parents (même adresse que son p: Living with her parents (same address as her father; the witness József Stollár also lives at István út 41).
en.Citoyen autrichien, domicilié légalement: Austrian citizen, legally domiciled in Malá Bělá (marriage record 1907). Relative of György: hypothesis (see Vencel).
en.Cité comme père du marié, 65 ans, vivant: Cited as father of the groom, 65, living, residing at Montluçon.
en.Citée comme marraine et « tante » de Gil: Cited as godmother and “aunt” of Gilbert Mazure (baptism, Lussat, 16 Oct. 1786): sister of Anne Bally, hence daughter of Jean Bally and Catherine Jamot. Source: AD Creuse, Lussat, BMS 1771-1792, 4E133/2, image 180/255: https://archives.creuse.fr/rechercher/archives-numerisees/registres-paroissiaux-et-de-letat-civil
en.Citée sous le nom « Macharovszky Tiborné: Listed as "Macharovszky Tiborné" (Mrs Tibor Macharovszky) in the directories of City of Budapest enterprises and employees, from 1935 to 1947. The notarial deeds of 1936 and 1943 name her Walter Margit and describe her as an office clerk (tisztviselőnő): so it is very probably her, not Kamilla Valek.
en.Commandant des pompiers volontaires de F: Commander of the Fichtenbach volunteer fire brigade (deputy: Michael Mack).
en.Confirmé en 1840 (baptême d'Anna, Doksy): Confirmed in 1840 (baptism of Anna, Doksy): "Revierjäger in Kaminken N. 4", already deceased.
en.Connu par l'acte de mariage de son fils: Known from the marriage record of his son Petr (23 Feb. 1784, Starý Plzenec): "Martini Macharovszky venatoris Netonicio Nro 24", already deceased. Place read as "Netonice", probably Netunice (16 km south of Plzeň); reading to be confirmed. Earliest known Macharowský.
en.Connu par le mariage de son fils Lucien: Known from the marriage of his son Lucien (Tours, 12 April 1890), at which he is present and consenting. Lucien was born at Loudun (Vienne) in 1872: look there for the Chenu × Mercier marriage and Lucien's birth (AD Vienne).

en.Date lue « vingt-six septembre mil huit: Date read as “vingt-six septembre mil huit cent cinquante (?)” [26 September 1850 (?)] in the legitimation record (1854); place Agen or Saint-Georges (Gers).

en.Date « 27 août 1800 (9 fructidor an VIII: Date “27 August 1800 (9 Fructidor Year VIII)” given by the birth extract cited in both his marriages (1830 and 1857); 29 years 5 months 11 days on 6 Feb. 1830. BUT the Concremiers register has no birth between 17 Thermidor (record 36) and 11 Fructidor (record 37) Year VIII; record no. 41 of 19 Fructidor Year VIII declares the birth on the previous day (18 Fructidor = 5 Sept. 1800), at Préguy (Concremiers), of a son “Silvain” of Marie Dugoulette, wife of a “mable c…” (= Amable Cerveux, written phonetically; in the margin “Silvain Mablou”). It is very probably him: the official date of the extract would be a misreading of “dix neuf” or “dix huit”.
en.De Vlčice (Blovice), fille de Václav Mrá: From Vlčice (Blovice), daughter of Václav Mráz, cooper.
en.Demande d'assistance à l'IRO comme réfug: Application to the IRO for assistance as a refugee: married, no religion, member of the Czechoslovak Socialist Party from 1930 to 1939. Refuses to return: “because I am a Czech socialist and do not agree with the communists”. Wishes to emigrate to Australia. His wife is not living with him (alone on the application).

en.Décès : « Hr. Petr Machalowský », garde-: Death: “Hr. Petr Machalowský”, gamekeeper, house no. 30, aged 53, died of consumption (“na souchotiny”), having received the sacraments; buried by the curate Josef Pánek. Kamínky no. 30 is the house where his son Antonín was born four months earlier. Confirmed by the death records of his son Josef (1840, “son of the late Petr Macharowský, forester at Kamínky”) and of his widow (1842).

en.Décès : « Kateřina Macharowská, veuve de: Death: “Kateřina Macharowská, widow of the late Petr Macharowský, forester (revírník) of Kamínky no. 33, Šťáhlavy estate”, living at Mirošov no. 91; aged 81, died of old age; buried on 1 February 1842 by the chaplain Franz Wild.
en.Décès : « Kateřina, fille de Josef Macha: Death: "Kateřina, daughter of Josef Macharowský, gamekeeper (myslivec) of Kamínky", house no. 34, about 2 years old; buried 25 April 1830 (Mirošov 17, p. 447, image 105).
en.Décès : « Pan Josef Macharowský, garde f: Death: “Mr Josef Macharowský, district forester (revírník, Revier-Förster) at Kamínky no. 33, Šťáhlavy estate, son of the late Petr Macharowský, forester at Kamínky”, aged 56, inflammatory nervous fever (typhus); buried on 2 March 1840 by the chaplain Franz Wild. Died in “Menet” on 9 Germinal year II.
en.Décédée avant 1811 dans une commune dont: Died before 1811 in a commune whose name is poorly read (“Malais…”); surname of uncertain reading.
en.Décédée à Jeaux (Mhère). Frères probable: Died at Jeaux (Mhère). Probable brothers: Pierre (c. 1844) and Philibert (c. 1832) Thomas, of Domont.
en.Déjà décédé en 1906 (« néhai » dans l'ac: Already deceased in 1906 ("néhai" in the death record of his son János).
en.Déplacements expliqués (recoupement, 7 o: Moves explained (cross-check, 7 Oct 2026): Šťáhlavy, Nebílovský Borek and Kamínky all belonged to one and the same estate, Šťáhlavy-Nebílovy (united in 1715, owned by the Czernins, then by the Waldsteins from 1816), which had 8 forest districts, including that of Kamínky (Sommer, Pilsner Kreis, 1838, p. 77). Petr therefore never changed employer: he was transferred from one keeper's post to another on the lands of the same lord.

en.Fille de Jan Weishäupl, garde-chasse (my: Daughter of Jan Weishäupl, gamekeeper (myslivec) at Kamínky, who died before 1830 (baptisms of her children at Mirošov, 1813, 1814, 1827 and 1830).
en.Fille de Jiří (Georg) Benda, cultivateur: Daughter of Jiří (Georg) Benda, farmer at Kluk no. 38, and of Kateřina Sommerová, of Podol no. 92 (Bělá pod Bezdězem parish).
en.Fille de Johann Wenzel Mander, de Tuhaň: Daughter of Johann Wenzel Mander, of Tuhaň no. 42, and of Anna Maria Wolf.
en.Fille de Josef Anderle, Revierförster à: Daughter of Josef Anderle, district forester at Nepomuk (Plzeň district), who died before 1874, and of Barbara née Kolbeck, of Neumark (Všeruby), Neugedein (Kdyně) district. en.HYPOTHÈSE PRINCIPALE (17 oct. 2026) : Ve: MAIN HYPOTHESIS (17 Oct 2026): Vencel would be Emanuel, son of Josef Macharowský and Marie Weishäupl, born 7 Nov 1822 at Planin no. 12. Arguments: (1) he is the conscript of the 1822 class “Wenzel Macharowský”, legal domicile Veselá (the municipality of Josef's family), absent in 1842; (2) his place of origin in 1855 reads “Planyin” (ending “-lanyin” certain, first letter read as P) = Planin, where Emanuel was born; (3) Emanuel is the only Macharowský boy born around 1820-1823 found in all the parishes of the Šťáhlavy estate, of eight neighbouring estates (Zbiroh, Strašice, Mýto, Mešno, Dolní Lukavice, Žinkovy…), of Nové Mitrovice, of Spálené Poříčí and of the two other “Planiny”; (4) Emanuel does not die at Planin or Kamínky and never appears again under that name; his godfather was called Wenzel. Weak point: the different first name (usual name or confirmation name not proven; confirmation registers not online).

en.IDENTIFICATION (14 oct. 2026) : l'« Anto: IDENTIFICATION (14 Oct. 2026): the “Antonia Macharovszky”, wife of the forester Antal Löschner at Menyháza (baptisms of 1886 and 1889), is this Antonia, daughter of Vinzenz: same couple as at the Kuřívody marriage (1882), the husband coming in both cases from Žákava (“Žakau”, Blovice district). The family therefore followed the Waldstein forestry network as far as Menyháza, as Vencel had done thirty years earlier. en.IDENTITÉ RÉGLÉE (14 oct. 2026) : son déc: IDENTITY SETTLED (14 Oct. 2026): his death at age 62 in 1893 matches the Václav born on 8 Jan. 1831 at Šťáhlavy. It is therefore he, and not Vencel of Hungary, who is the son Václav of Václav the elder and Antonia Bauda. The “Wenzel” in the fire-brigade directories after 1893 is either an out-of-date directory entry or a namesake.
en.IDENTITÉ À TRANCHER : le seul fils Václa: IDENTITY TO BE SETTLED: the couple’s only known son named Václav is Vencel, born 8 January 1831 at Šťáhlavy, whom the tree identifies (as a hypothesis) with Vencel of Menyháza in Hungary. Either this Wenzel of Fichtenbach IS the Václav of 1831 (and Vencel of Hungary is someone else), or he is a son born after 1843 at Thammühl (Doksy) not yet found. His age (marriage or death record) will settle it. His rank of assistant forester in 1868 rather suggests a young man (born about 1840-1846).
en.Identification possible avec Maria Victo: Possible identification with Maria Victorina (I163), born on 13 Sept. 1824 at Šťáhlavy, daughter of Wenzel Macharowský and Antonia Bauda: see the note on Kateřina (I166), her sister, whose mother was “widow of a forester in Bohemia” in 1861.

en.LIEN HYPOTHÉTIQUE (16 oct. 2026) : Vence: HYPOTHETICAL LINK (16 Oct. 2026): Vencel is provisionally attached to Josef Macharowský (1784) and Marie Weishäupl so as not to lose the link with the Bohemian family. Reason: in 1855 he gave his origin as “Planyin”, and Josef was gamekeeper at Planin (Nebílovský Borek no. 12) from 1817 to 1825, while Vencel was born around 1822. NOT PROVEN: no baptism of a Václav found at Chválenice (1805-1840), and Josef already has children born on 29 Sept. 1820 (Ignác) and 7 Nov. 1822 (Emanuel). The father could also be another son of Petr (Jan Nepomuk 1787, František 1788, Vojtěch 1790). Link to be removed if a record proves otherwise.
en.LIEU D'ORIGINE RELU (12 oct. 2026) : l'a: PLACE OF ORIGIN RE-READ (12 Oct 2026): the 1855 record reads “Hanyin in Bohemia” (a single H, same stroke as in “Hofbauer” on the same page; a-n-y-i-n; the “in” on the next line is the Latin word). Hungarian “ny” = ň: the priest wrote [haňín], i.e. “Hanín” as pronounced in Czech. Not identified: the Hanín wood (Lysá nad Labem / Přerov nad Labem / Semice) and Chynín (Nové Mitrovice) both checked negative in the baptisms 1807-1840 / 1820-1823. As Václav the elder only married in 1824, Vencel (born c. 1822) is more likely a son of Josef (1784), Jan Nepomuk (1787), František (1788) or Vojtěch (1790), gamekeepers posted who knows where around 1822.

en.Lui : Mayer Maxmilian József, fils de Jó: Groom: Mayer Maxmilian József, son of József Mayer and Theresia Krayer, born at Temesvár-Gyárváros, living in Budapest, 27, single. Bride: Macharovszky Anna, daughter of Macharovszky Wenzel and Vanyek Borbála, born at Boros-Sebes, living at Sebes, 24, single.
en.Légitime, maison Ferdinandsberg n° 60. P: Legitimate; house Ferdinandsberg no. 60. Godparents: Emanuel Barton, forester, and his wife Maria. Baptised by Josephus Adleth (?), vice-archdeacon and parish priest of Caransebeș.
en.Légitime. Maison : Ferdinandsberg, sans: Legitimate. House: Ferdinandsberg, no number. Godmother: Antonia Macharovszký, widow of a forester in Bohemia (probably her grandmother), represented by the midwife Theresia Stockhalm. Baptised by Josephus Adleth, parish priest.
en.Magyar Híradó (Vienne), 24 mars 1962 : u: Magyar Híradó (Vienna), 24 March 1962: a Hungarian journalist meets him near Lavagna, "between Chiavari and Sestri Levante"; he introduces himself: "Weichherz Jenő a nevem, és nyáron szállóigazgató vagyok Sestriben". The article says he was born in Pola, to a father who was a naval engineer and an Italian mother who lives in Budapest, retired, aged 90. Full article for Arcanum subscribers only (read from snippets).
en.Magyar Híradó (Vienne), 24 mars 1962 : «: Magyar Híradó (Vienna), 24 March 1962: "hadapródiskolában kezdte, a milánói világhírű Motta cégnél folytatta és mint sestri levantei szállóigazgató fejezte be karrierjét".
en.Maison forestière n° 4 près du moulin de: Forester's house no. 4 near the dam mill (Podhrázský mlýn) of the great pond (Lake Mácha). Probable current address: Dalibora z Myšlina 4, Staré Splavy, 471 63 Doksy (the current č.p. 4 is opposite the mill; building not necessarily original). 1843 cadastre: area already built up opposite the mill (built plot of the mill no. 398); the map gives plot numbers, not house numbers.
en.Maison n° 34. Père : Josef Macharowský,: House no. 34. Father: Josef Macharowský, gamekeeper (myslivec) at Kamínky, son of the late Petr Macharowský, former gamekeeper at Kamínky, and of Kateřina Waltrová. Mother: Marie, daughter of the late Jan Weishäupl, gamekeeper at Kamínky. Baptised by Jos. Landsfeld, chaplain. Godfather: Johann (?), employee (?) at Kamínky (uncertain reading).
en.Marchand à Viersat (1793), menuisier à T: Merchant at Viersat (1793), joiner at Teillet-Argenty (1799). Descendants at Teillet-Argenty and Montluçon (including Joseph, solicitor at Montluçon, † 1863).
en.Mariage avant août 1852, probablement en: Marriage before August 1852, probably in Bohemia (bride's parish: that of Neubrück(e)?, or Dolní Krupá). Not found at Doksy (index 1839-1863). The couple lives at Dolní Krupá no. 63 (1852), then at the forester's lodge of Radechov (1854), then leaves for the Banat before 1859.
en.Mariage avant décembre 1813 : premier en: Marriage before December 1813: first known child (Josef) born 7 December 1813 at Kamínky. Baptismal extract of Josef issued on 14 June 1818; marriage not found at Šťáhlavy.
en.Mariage avec Adélaïde Lefort non trouvé: Marriage to Adélaïde Lefort not found at Monfréville (indexes 1843-1862): search at Cerisy-la-Forêt or La Haye-du-Puits (Manche), c. 1845-1854.
en.Mariage avec Marie Dugoulet non trouvé (: Marriage to Marie Dugoulet not found (17 Oct. 2026): absent from the Concremiers marriages of year V and year VI (3 E 058/04) and from the two Concremiers marriages celebrated at the canton seat of Le Blanc in year VII and year VIII (3 E 018/16, images 40 and 85). The eldest son Jean was born c. 1799: marriage c. 1797-1798, perhaps in Saint-Hilaire or in Le Blanc.
en.Mariage avec Miksa Mayer introuvable : T: Marriage to Miksa Mayer not found: Terézváros 1889 read in full (FamilySearch, film 007993440).
en.Mariage connu par la mention en marge du: Marriage known from the margin note on Tibor's baptism: “cop. Óbuda 1923 szept. 9. cum Walter Margit”. The record itself is not indexed on FamilySearch. In 1955 Tibor's wife was Kamilla Valek, so Margit Walter was his first wife (death or divorce to be found).
en.Mariage célébré par l'administrateur de: Marriage performed by the parish administrator Jos. Zimmerhackl; banns read on the 3rd and 4th Sundays after Epiphany and on Septuagesima. Groom: “Emanuel Barton”, huntsman (uncertain reading: Leibjäger?), no. 201, aged 32, Catholic, single, “legitimate son of the late Ignaz Barton, burgher of Münchengrätz [Mnichovo Hradiště] no. 241, and of … née Holitzer(?), of the same place no. 241”. Bride: “Maria Victoria Macharowsky”, aged 22, single, “legitimate daughter of Wenzel Macharowsky, Revierförster at Schloßbösig no. 71, and of Antonia Bauda, of Mirošov no. 84”. The father consents to the marriage of his under-age daughter and signs (“Wenzel Macharowsky, Vater”); witnesses to this consent: Franz Planer(?) and Anton Barton. Marriage witnesses: … Weiß(?) and Franz Pietsch, manorial district forester (the same name Pietsch appears among the Borossebes foresters in 1856).
en.Mariage dissous par jugement de divorce: Marriage dissolved by divorce judgment of the civil court of Tours of 22 Dec. 1921, transcribed on 11 July 1922 (marginal note on the marriage record).
en.Mariage non encore trouvé (Bakov ou Mnic: Marriage not yet found (Bakov or Mnichovo Hradiště, around 1905-1910).
en.Mariage non trouvé : ni à Buteni (1850-1: Marriage not found: not at Buteni (1850-1855), nor at Doksy, Mimoň, Svébořice or Holičky (1844-1855).
en.Mariage non trouvé dans les TD de Goudou: Marriage not found in the Goudourville ten-year indexes 1823-1832 and 1833-1842 (only “Lavilledieu Jean × Élisabeth Saingayrac, 8 April 1828” is found there, probably another Jean or a first marriage — to be checked). To be searched for in the bride's commune.
en.Mariage non trouvé en ligne (registres c: Marriage not found online (the Catholic marriage registers of Caransebeș/Ferdinandsberg 1850-1863 are not on Ancestry or FamilySearch).
en.Mariage à Mladá Boleslav. Lui : tonnelie: Marriage in Mladá Boleslav. Groom: cooper at Klášter no. 1, aged 31, Catholic, single, native of Tuhaň, with right of domicile (příslušný) at Tamín(?) near Doksy. Bride: aged 25. Witnesses: Václav Hahn, tailor, and Antonín Lübner, wheelwright, of Mladá Boleslav.
en.Mariage à Náchod. Témoins : Václav Malý: Marriage in Náchod. Witnesses: Václav Malý and Josef Žitka.
en.Marié au moins trois fois à Bélâbre : 1): Married at least three times at Bélâbre: 1) on 25 Feb. 1811 (no. 3) to Catherine Cerveux, born at Bélâbre on 6 Jan. 1785, daughter of Silvain Cerveux, ploughman, and of the late Anne André (witnesses: Silvain Cerveux, father, Jean Cerveux, Pierre Gault, brother of the groom, Jean Cerveux, brother of the bride) — a Catherine Cerveux died at Bélâbre on 28 Sept. 1815 (ten-year index); 2) a Catherine “Ferront” (?), who died at Bélâbre on 17 March 1821 and whose widower he was in 1823 (marriage not found in the 1813-1822 index); 3) on 10 Feb. 1823 to Marie Rouillard. Possible link between the Catherine Cerveux of Bélâbre and the Cerveux of Le Blanc (Silvain, son-in-law of Louis Gault in 1857): to be investigated.
Married twice in Le Blanc: 1) on 6 Feb. 1830 to Anne Chapoton (died in Le Blanc on 27 March 1857); 2) on 9 May 1857 to Marie Gault. Louis (1858) is the son of Marie Gault; Joseph (c. 1841, plumber in Paris in 1880) is probably from the first marriage. Brothers: Jean (c. 1799) and François (c. 1807-1811), witnesses at his first marriage.
en.Marié quatre fois d'après les arbres Gen: Married four times according to the Geneanet trees (philorhant, eolland): Henriette Alphonsine Louise Lefèvre (Sartrouville, 23 August 1899 — date checked on the record, the tree said 23 April —, † 1900); Juliette Marie Lefèvre (Sartrouville, 27 June 1901, divorced; children Raymonde 1905-1997 and Suzanne); Joséphine Élodie Dèche (Maisons-Laffitte, 7 Nov. 1936, marriage contract before Me Albert Praquin, notary at Sartrouville, 28 Oct. 1936; children Jack and Jean); Madeleine Toussaint (Maisons-Laffitte, 7 Dec. 1946; son Pierre).
en.Mariée le 30 sept. 1882 à Kuřívody avec: Married on 30 Sept 1882 at Kuřívody to Anton Löschner, 31, forester of Count Waldstein (in 1870 “Forst-Praktikant” at Weisswasser / Bělá pod Bezdězem), son of Franz Löschner and Josefa Pokorný. In the record: “Antonia, legitimate daughter of the late Vinzenz Macharovský, former district forester of Count Waldstein, and of Josefa née Weiß”.
en.Marraine : « Antonia Macharovszký vidua: Godmother: “Antonia Macharovszký vidua forestarii in Bohemia” (widow of a forester in Bohemia), absent, replaced by the midwife Theresia Stockhalm.
en.Marraine avec son mari « Emmanuel Barton: Godmother, with her husband “Emmanuel Barton”, of Rosalia, daughter of Wenceslaus Dicke(?) and Anna Horn, of Láz no. 1; she signs “Maria Macharofsky”.
en.Marraine de Maria, fille aînée de Vencel: Godmother of Maria, Vencel's eldest daughter, under the name “Maria Barton”.
en.Marraine de sa petite-fille Gabriella An: Godmother of her granddaughter Gabriella Antonia Procházka: “Antonia Macharowsky, Försters Witwe in Weißwasser”. Already a widow in May 1856. Her death is not in the Bělá pod Bezdězem index (1855-1885): she probably left Bělá (in 1861 she is still alive, perhaps already in the Banat with her daughter).
en.Mention en marge de son mariage. Acte de: Marginal note on his marriage. Death record no. 580 of 16 May 1933 (Cluj town hall, not online).
en.Mention en marge du baptême : « † 11/2 1: Note in the margin of the baptism: “† 11/2 1941 i. Wiesengrund”. Wiesengrund is the German name of Dobřany, home of the large psychiatric hospital of West Bohemia. In 1940 the Leitmeritz court had placed him under guardianship (see the 1940 event).
en.Mention en marge du baptême : « † 21/6 1: Note in the margin of the baptism: “† 21/6 1927 v Louvres ve Francii (zavražděn)” (murdered). A Prague student who had passed his school-leaving exam in May 1927, killed aged 21 near Paris with Ladislav Klika and František Müller; the murderer, Rudolf Skalský, was tried in Prague in 1929.
en.Mention en marge du baptême : « † 9/2 19: Note in the margin of the baptism: “† 9/2 1919 v Ml. Boleslavi”. Died aged 29; death record to be looked for in Mladá Boleslav (1919).
Note in the margin of the baptism record.
en.Mention en marge « † 11/2 1941 », lieu m: Note in the margin “† 11/2 1941”, place poorly read.
en.Mention marginale (17 nov. 1936) : légit: Marginal note (17 Nov. 1936): legitimated by the marriage of Paul Bailly and Joséphine Élodie Dèche. It is through this note, and not through the marriage record, that the link is established.
en.Mention marginale : mariage dissous par: Marginal note: marriage dissolved by judgment of the Paris Court of Appeal, 8th chamber, of 1 December 1920, transcribed on 4 April 1921.
en.Mention marginale : morts les 16 et 25 f: Marginal note: died on 16 and 25 February 1788 (see his twin Maur).
en.Mention marginale : reconnu par Joséphin: Marginal note: acknowledged by Joséphine Élodie Dèche.
en.Mention marginale : reconnu par Paul Bai: Marginal note: acknowledged by Paul Bailly.
en.Mention marginale : « obierunt le 16e et: Marginal note: “obierunt le 16e et le 25e ejusdem” — the twins died on 16 and 25 February 1788 (the order is not specified). No burial record: the 1788 burial register begins in March.
en.Mention marginale de l'acte de naissance: Marginal note on the birth record of Alphonse Chenu (AD Indre-et-Loire, Tours, 1909, 6NUM8/261/378, record no. 1262). Marriage record: AD Paris, 19th arr., marriages 1936, 19M 346 (register 11 July-22 Aug. 1936): https://archives.paris.fr
Marginal note on the groom's birth record (Maisy, 1877): “by deed dated the fifth (?) of August 1904, registered at the town hall of Monfréville”.
en.Mise sous tutelle (Entmündigung) par le: Placed under guardianship (Entmündigung) by the Leitmeritz court
en.Mort avant le 10 nov. 1861 : sa femme An: Died before 10 Nov. 1861: his wife Antonia is then called “widow of a forester in Bohemia” (baptism of his granddaughter Victoria Antonia Prochaszka at Caransebeș).
en.Mort le 27 juin 1900 à 5 h du matin, ent: Died on 27 June 1900 at 5 a.m., buried on the 29th in Bakov. Factory worker at Malá Bělá no. 30, married, aged 42. “Son of František Macharovský, tenant at Rečkov no. 5; born at Rečkov no. 5 on 22 January 1858; married in Bakov on 19 January 1880.”
en.Mort le 9 juillet 1910 à 5 h 30 du matin: Died on 9 July 1910 at 5:30 a.m. in the hospital at Mladá Boleslav (no. 147-II), buried on the 11th. Single, coachman at Malá Bělá, aged 20. “Son of Josef Macharovský, retired farmer (výměnkář) of Malá Bělá no. 13, and of Anna née Volfová.” The note in the margin of the baptism reads “† 9/7 1910” (not 9/2 1919). No wife or children. (Josef, the father, had in fact died in 1900.)
en.Mort à 6 mois, d'hydrocéphalie, à Podol: Died aged 6 months, of hydrocephalus, at Podol no. 5; buried on 13 December at Bělá. The Bělá death record calls the father “Josef” and the mother “Barbora Brázová, of Věžec”: a mistake by the Bělá priest. The note in the margin of the baptism (same child, same date of death, buried at Bělá) proves he was the son of František and Barbora Mrázová, who had settled in Podol by late 1865.
en.Morte en 1714 d'après l'arbre Geneanet c: Died in 1714 according to the Geneanet tree chemanla — not verified.
en.Morte le 18 juillet 1902 à 8 h du matin,: Died on 18 July 1902 at 8 a.m., buried on the 20th in Bakov, aged 45. “Widow of Josef Macharovský, factory worker at Malá Bělá no. 30; daughter of Jan Volf, tenant at Sol(?) no. 2, and of Barbora née Dreslerová of Malobratřice no. 13; born at Zakopaná on 20 April 1856.” (The index puts her in 1900: an error in the index.)
en.Morte à 10 h du soir, à 5 mois, de convu: Died at 10 p.m., aged 5 months, of convulsions (psotník); buried on 8 August at 9 a.m. by the chaplain Josef Bušek. The record calls her “daughter of Theodor Macharovský, merchant at Bělá no. 43, and of Anna née Bendová, of Kluk no. 38”. The marginal note “† 1872” also appears on the baptism record.
en.Mère attestée par le mariage de sa fille: Mother attested by the marriage of her daughter Françoise: AD Tarn-et-Garonne, Cazes-Mondenard, marriages 1821-1822, 6 E 042/18 (sub-vol. 06), image 44, record no. 16 of 31 May 1822: https://recherche.archives82.fr

Mother attested by the marriage of her daughter Marguerite: AD Tarn-et-Garonne, Durfort, parishes of Saint-Hilaire, Saint-Paul-d'Elburgues and Saint-Martin, BMS 1751-1757 (court-registry copy), 6 E 051/5 (sub-vol. 03), image 18 (year 1754): https://recherche.archives82.fr
en.Mère célibataire de Viktória (1872, Fere: Unmarried mother of Viktória (1872, Ferencváros) and Béla (1874, Józsefváros). The baptisms give neither her age nor her origin: that she is the daughter of János Pesch and Terézia Fischer born in 1851 is a deduction (same name, same parishes, and Viktória cannot be their daughter).
en.Mère d'Anne Thaumioux (acte de mariage d: Mother of Anne Thaumioux (1783 marriage record, read).
en.Mère d'Étienne. Nom lu « Neny » sur l'ac: Mother of Étienne. Name read “Neny” on the 1709 record (uncertain reading); Nurry/Nury in the trees.
en.Mère de Françoise : « Gilberte Turcat »: Mother of Françoise: “Gilberte Turcat” in the 1734 marriage record (read; reading confirmed by jeansebmartin). Parents according to jeansebmartin: Jean Turcat (c. 1636-1724) and Gabrielle Fonvielle (c. 1640-1675). The philorhant tree wrongly gave Louis Gagnière and Catherine Vincent.
en.Mère de Françoise Chatard ; citée vivant: Mother of Françoise Chatard; mentioned as living in 1810. Source: AD Allier, Lamaids, marriages Year V-1862, 2 E 132/4, image 26/173 (record no. 1, 17 Jan. 1810); index image 30: https://archives.allier.fr/rechercher/archives-numerisees/genealogie-histoire-des-familles/etat-civil-en-ligne
en.Mère de Françoise Mérie ; vivante en 182: Mother of Françoise Mérie; living in 1822, present at and consenting to her marriage. Françoise's father is not named in the 1822 record.
en.Mère de Jeanne Catusse au baptême de 178: Mother of Jeanne Catusse at the 1780 baptism (“Jeanne Dessus Lamote”); the godmother bears the same name (Jeanne Dessus-Lamothe, probably a relative).
en.Mère de Marguerite Bonal selon l'acte de: Mother of Marguerite Bonal according to the 1754 marriage record (name barely legible: Cabalbert?). The first name of the father, Bonal, could not be read.
en.Mère naturelle de Pauline Louise Beaumon: Natural mother of Pauline Louise Beaumon (born in 1874 at Hüttenheim); in 1890 wife of Charles Colin, day labourer, residing at Saint-Symphorien (now Tours).
en.Mère non mariée de Pierre Auguste (March: Unmarried mother of Pierre Auguste (Marchésieux, 1849); called “Rose Sauvage” in the Marchésieux index. A Louise Adélaïde Sauvage married an Ouzy (?) in Marchésieux on 20 July 1848 (annual index): possibly a sister. Possible link with Virginie Modeste Sauvage (c. 1812, maternal grandmother of Florence Le Rille) to be investigated.
en.NOUVEL ARGUMENT (14 oct. 2026) : sa sœur: NEW ARGUMENT (14 Oct. 2026): his probable sister Catharina (= Kateřina, born in 1829 at Šťáhlavy, daughter of Wenzel and Antonia Bauda) lives in the Banat with her forester husband, and their mother Antonia, “widow of a forester in Bohemia”, is godmother in 1861. This strengthens the attachment of Vencel to this sibling group (Václav, born in 1831), despite the age of 33 given in 1855.
en.Naissance de sa fille Gizella (1897) : «: Birth of her daughter Gizella (1897): "Macharovszky Anna, born in Borosjenő, Catholic, age 35". There is also a Pilisborosjenő near Budapest, but the one in Arad is the most likely.
Nemzeti Ujság, no. 51 of 2 March 1928, p. 24 (society column), and Magyar Külpolitika, 1 March 1928: "Magyarok a milánói főkonzulnál". The Royal Hungarian Consul General Tibor Petér and his wife receive the Hungarian community of Milan on a Sunday afternoon (probably 26 February 1928). Among the guests: Baron József Krafft and his wife, Branco Gallia and his wife, "Weichherz Jenő és felesége", the editor József Erdőssy. The gathering allowed members "recently settled in Milan" to [get acquainted]: the couple probably arrived shortly after the 1925 marriage. Text reconstructed from snippets (subscriber-only page).
Direct link: https://newspapers.arcanum.com/hu/view/NemzetiUjsag_1928_03/?pg=24
en.Nom confirmé « Mérie » par son acte de m: Name confirmed as “Mérie” by her marriage record (1822) and the birth of her daughter Marie (1829). In 1822 she was a hired servant (“gagiste”) of Jean Boral at the place called Batteuc (?), chapel-of-ease of Rouzet (?).
en.Nom de lecture incertaine (« Vaishaiplov: Name of uncertain reading ("Vaishaiplová", 1859). Weishäupl family attested in Šťáhlavy.
en.Nom de lecture incertaine (« de Chassat: Name of uncertain reading (“de Chassat”). Possible link with Marie Dechassat, wife of François Bally (1769). Source: AD Creuse, Lussat, BMS 1737-1770, 4E133/1, image 68/273 (2 Nov. 1746): https://archives.creuse.fr/rechercher/archives-numerisees/registres-paroissiaux-et-de-letat-civil
en.Nom de lecture très incertaine (« Proly: Name of very uncertain reading (“Proly Mary”) in the marriage record of the son Pierre Neveux (Oulches, 1828); the record mentions “le quinze vendémiaire l'an onze” (7 Oct. 1802), perhaps the date of death.
en.Nom lu « Chalon » dans l'acte de naissan: Name read “Chalon” in the birth record of her son Pierre (1852); “Chaslon” (?) in the 1875 marriage record. Living in 1875, no occupation, at Goudourville.
en.Nom lu « Sati » à la naissance de son fi: Name read as “Sati” at the birth of her son Jean (1804), “Gazy” (?) at the 1850 marriage — probably Sazy/Sati. Living in 1850.
en.Nom lu « Servat » (?) dans l'acte de mar: Name read “Servat” (?) in the daughter's marriage record (1777), to be confirmed.
en.Nom peu lisible au mariage de son fils (: Name hard to read at her son's marriage (1776): “Sintou” (?), a reading supported by the Geneanet tree chemanla. Living (?) in 1776.
en.Nom écrit Aubret (1857) et Aubray (1858,: Name written Aubret (1857) and Aubray (1858, 1869). Natural daughter of Marie Aubret; maternal uncle Pierre Aubret, carpenter at Le Blanc (46 in 1857); Silvain Aubray, sharecropper at Cochet (42 in 1858), witness to the birth of Marie Neveux.
en.Nom écrit « Cassagne » au baptême de sa: Name written “Cassagne” at the baptism of her daughter Jeanne (Golfech, 1778); read as “Rataigue” (?) in her daughter's marriage record (Year XIII); “Cassaigne” according to the Geneanet tree chemanla. Living in 1805; “feue” (the late) in 1851. Also written “Cassagne” in her daughter's death record (1851).
en.Nom écrit « Celis » (1763), « Selles » (: Name written “Celis” (1763), “Selles” (?) (1753), “Selier” (?) (year XIII); “Selsis” according to the Geneanet tree chemanla, which says she was born in 1723. From a parish in Quercy (name hard to read in the 1753 record).
en.Nom écrit « Prohiszka » ; forme tchèque: Name written “Prohiszka”; probable Czech form: Procházka.
en.Nom écrit « Sazi » dans son acte de mari: Name written “Sazi” in her marriage record (Year XIII), “Sati” (?) in 1804, “Gazy” (?) in 1850; “Gary” in the 1802-1808 ten-year index (copyist's misreading).
en.Nom écrit « Xalon » dans son acte de mar: Name written “Xalon” in her marriage record (1850), “Chalon” in 1852, “Chaslon” (?) in 1875.
en.Nommé(e) dans l'acte de mariage de Nicol: Named in the marriage record of Nicolas Mazure (Lussat, 18 Jan. 1780: “son of the late Annet and of Marie Ribe”) — AD Creuse, Lussat, 4E133/2, image 94/255. Annet was already dead in 1780. The name Ribbe is indeed found at Lussat (godmother Marie Ribbe, 1763).
en.Nommée « Gilberte Brandonet » dans l'act: Named “Gilberte Brandonet” in the marriage record of her son Nicolas (Teillet, 24 Feb. 1699). Dates to be researched.
en.Nommée « Isabeau Cassan » au baptême de: Named “Isabeau Cassan” at the baptism of her daughter Marianne (1781); “Élisabeth Catus (?)” in the 1812 marriage record (difficult reading — Isabeau = Élisabeth).
en.Nommée « Marianne Borredon » dans l'acte: Named “Marianne Borredon” in the birth record of her son Jean (1817). Spelling of the name to be confirmed (Borredon / Bourdon?).
